_comment: Accepted deviations between the DOCX link model and the Markdown, decided by Andras Iklody on 2026-09-11 (PRD ~/prds/taxii-spec.prd.md, Q1/Q3/Q6). 'text' is the link text in the DOCX ('*' = any); 'docx' the target identity found in the DOCX; 'md' the identity the Markdown must use (null = the link is dropped); optional 'md_text' if the link span is normalised.
